text:
alex_m: Heads-up — our inference queue is spiking and we need to lock extra A100 capacity in us-west1 for Q2. Current spare = 6, projected need = +40. Lead times vendor-side reported 6–8 weeks. CC @maria_g @ryan_k @sophie_f

maria_g: which k8s pool is this for? can we shift anything to other regions instead of committing?

alex_m: r-inference-prod-usw1. Shifting helps but we still need a baseline reservation for steady traffic and canaries. Options: reserved commitment, temporary burst, or cross-region routing.

ryan_k: vendor told us last week they can supply some burst capacity but reservations (12mo commit) have the long lead time. spots/preemptible available but risky for prod.

alex_m: finance flagged that a 12mo commitment needs 50–70% utilization to make sense. want to model cost delta vs continued on-demand/burst.

sophie_f: I saw the billing uptick — monthly infra spend +27% last month due to more eval runs. Send me a 3-tier forecast (conservative/expected/high) and we can run the commit analysis.

alex_m: attaching quick calc in thread:
```
# rough GPU-week calc (expected)
qps = 12k
avg_tokens_per_request = 900
tokens_per_gpu_hour = 36M
weekly_gpu_hours_needed = (qps * avg_tokens_per_request * 3600 * 24 * 7) / tokens_per_gpu_hour
=> ~1,800 GPU-hours/week => ~40 A100-equivalent slots steady
```

ryan_k: other levers: 1) quantize models to reduce memory footprint (could squeeze more per GPU), 2) route non-latency-sensitive jobs to preemptible/spot, 3) cross-region split (us-east/eu) to use available inventory.

maria_g: inventory note: queue ticket backlog shows several pending reservations. Current reservation ticket #4321 (P2) waiting on vendor procurement. Lead times in tracker: 6–8 weeks average.

vendor-bot: Vendor update — account team response: preliminary availability: 24 A100s in us-west targeted by 2026-04-10, additional 20 by 2026-05-01. Dates are estimates and subject to change pending shipment.

alex_m: given that, propose: reserve the 24 now (earliest delivery), then cover remaining 16 by cross-region routing + short-term burst. Also propose we open a formal escalation with vendor AM to accelerate the second tranche.

ryan_k: operational plan: implement routing policy to send traffic to us-east/eu for lower-priority endpoints and enable autoscaler for burst pool. Burst cost ~1.8x on-demand. We'll gate this to non-prod and less stringent SLAs.

sophie_f: finance rules: if committing 40 GPUs for 12mo, we need projected utilization >= 40% with monthly forecast and expected savings comparison. If the commit saves >40% over on-demand, we can approve. Send me the cost delta table.

alex_m: I'll run sims and produce the spreadsheet by EOD. Requesting preliminary approval to open a commit request in vendor portal so we don't lose the 24-unit slot.

infra-bot: infra-bot: Created ticket INF-1987: "Reserve 24 A100s in us-west1 (initial tranche)" assigned to @ryan_k. ETA for action: vendor portal form submitted.

ryan_k: opening infra PR to add cross-region routing + autoscaler. Will include feature flag so we can toggle burst behaviors per route.

maria_g: quick reminder: cross-region routing increases egress costs and tail-latency. Include egress delta and p99 latency impact in the evaluation matrix.

alex_m: noted — will include egress delta. Also asking Eng leadership to sign off on the financial commit request tomorrow morning. @sophie_f can you fast-track finance review once I share the forecast?

sophie_f: yes — tag me on the ticket. If the numbers show >40% savings vs on-demand for typical Q2 workloads we'll escalate for exec sign-off.

alex_m: thanks everyone — I'll post the spreadsheet and recommended commit vs burst mix in this thread by EOD. If vendor AM confirms earlier delivery I'll update delivery dates.

maria_g: appreciate it. small follow-up: please add a fallback policy so if vendor-delivery slips we automatically route additional traffic to spots rather than creating a queue backlog.

alex_m: will do. escalating to @infra-lead for visibility. :arrow_up:

vendor-bot: Vendor note: AM assigned — outreach scheduled. Expect confirmation email within 48h.

ryan_k: moving to action items: INF-1987 reserve 24, INF-1988 cross-region routing PR, FIN-1024 commit evaluation spreadsheet.

sophie_f: thumbs-up. finance will standby to approve commit cap increase if forecast meets threshold.

alex_m: signing off for now — ping me on thread for any blocker.
